summary: Frontend smoke and responsive testing completed for GreenFork login, overview, orders, menu, route navigation, mobile navigation, and target breakpoints.

integration_issues.issue: Save item closes the modal but does not add the entered item to the menu or persist it in state.

action_items: Implement add-item save behavior: validate inputs, append the new menu item, and render it after modal close.
Consider showing the resulting rejected status in the order detail panel; the queue state updates but the detail panel has no explicit rejected label.
Replace or wire the intentionally MOCKED in-memory service adapters before production use.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu save currently only calls setModal(false), so the primary Add item action silently discards user input.
The service adapters are MOCKED and are not consumed by App.js; all domain state remains local and is lost on reload.
seed_data_creation: None; used the existing seeded mock orders and menu items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login, overview, order accept/filter flow, stock toggle, route rendering, mobile bottom nav, and horizontal overflow passed. Recheck add-item persistence and explicit rejected-detail presentation after fixes. Some route-title assertions were affected by animation timing, but routes visibly rendered in source/manual review.
rca of the issue: The MenuPage save handler is hardcoded to setModal(false) and never reads the two input values or calls setItems. Consequently the modal closes while no new menu card can appear. Order update state does update selected/order collection, but Detail only renders action controls while status is new and has no explicit rejected status presentation. All domain integrations are intentionally MOCKED per the product architecture.
